title.title: Virasoro constraints for every complete intersection
title.subtitle: Claim: the full descendant Virasoro conjecture for every smooth complete intersection, no semisimplicity

plain: All curve counts on a shape obey one infinite family of equations, as physicists predicted

beats.text: $Z_X$ packs every Gromov–Witten invariant of $X$, in all genera
The conjecture: infinitely many differential equations annihilate it
Claimed for complete intersections, including odd and primitive classes

achievement.label: Virasoro conjecture (Eguchi–Hori–Xiong, 1997)
statement: L_k Z_X = 0 \text{ for every smooth complete intersection } X
achievement.note: A companion passes the constraints to projective bundles

verify.detail: No Lean; the projective-bundle companion is conditional by design
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and caveats; we did not check the proof

voice.text: One function packs every Gromov-Witten count of a space.
The conjecture: infinitely many operators all send it to zero.
Claimed: every smooth complete intersection, with no semisimplicity needed.

sources.quote: Eguchi–Hori–Xiong (1997) Virasoro conjecture; proved for P¹ (Okounkov–Pandharipande 2006), toric/semisimple (Givental 2001; Teleman 2012 for semisimple)
